defmodule Logistics.Freight do

    resource Logistics.Freight.Carrier

  end

defmodule Logistics.Freight.Carrier do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: Logistics.Freight,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer

  postgres do
    table "carriers"
    repo Logistics.Repo
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :create, :update, :destroy]
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :code, :ci_string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :name, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :retired_at, :utc_datetime_usec
  end

  identities do
    identity :unique_code, [:code], where: expr(is_nil(retired_at))
  end
end

defmodule Logistics.Freight.Warehouse do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: Logistics.Freight,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer

  postgres do
    table "warehouses"
    repo Logistics.Repo
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :create, :update, :destroy]
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :code, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :name, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :region, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :capacity_parcels, :integer, allow_nil?: false, default: 0
    attribute :decommissioned, :boolean, allow_nil?: false, default: false
  end

  identities do
    identity :unique_active_code, [:code], where: expr(decommissioned == false)
  end

  relationships do
    has_many :legs, Logistics.Freight.ShipmentLeg
  end
end

defmodule Logistics.Freight.Shipment do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: Logistics.Freight,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer

  postgres do
    table "shipments"
    repo Logistics.Repo
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :create, :update, :destroy]

    create :intake do
      argument :parcels, {:array, :map}, allow_nil?: false
      change manage_relationship(:parcels, type: :create)
    end
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :reference, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :status, :atom, constraints: [one_of: [:draft, :booked, :in_transit, :delivered, :cancelled]], allow_nil?: false, default: :draft
    attribute :declared_value_cents, :integer, allow_nil?: false, default: 0
    attribute :scheduled_for, :utc_datetime
    attribute :booked_at, :utc_datetime_usec, default: &DateTime.utc_now/0
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :carrier, Logistics.Freight.Carrier, allow_nil?: false
    belongs_to :origin_warehouse, Logistics.Freight.Warehouse
    has_many :parcels, Logistics.Freight.Parcel
    has_many :legs, Logistics.Freight.ShipmentLeg
  end

  identities do
    identity :unique_reference, [:reference]
  end

  aggregates do
    aggregate :parcel_count, :parcels, :count
    aggregate :total_weight_grams, :parcels, :sum, field: :weight_grams
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :heavy?, :boolean, expr(total_weight_grams > 5000)
  end
end

defmodule Logistics.Freight.Parcel do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: Logistics.Freight,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer

  postgres do
    table "parcels"
    repo Logistics.Repo
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :create, :update, :destroy]
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :tracking_code, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :weight_grams, :integer, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :fragile, :boolean, allow_nil?: false, default: false
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :shipment, Logistics.Freight.Shipment, allow_nil?: false
  end

  identities do
    identity :unique_tracking_code, [:tracking_code]
    identity :single_fragile_per_shipment, [:shipment_id], where: expr(fragile == true)
  end
end

defmodule Logistics.Freight.ShipmentLeg do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: Logistics.Freight,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer

  postgres do
    table "shipment_legs"
    repo Logistics.Repo
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :create, :update, :destroy]
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :sequence, :integer, allow_nil?: false
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :shipment, Logistics.Freight.Shipment, allow_nil?: false
    belongs_to :warehouse, Logistics.Freight.Warehouse, allow_nil?: false
  end

  identities do
    identity :unique_leg_sequence, [:shipment_id, :sequence]
  end
end
